_note: Genuine reference problems, adjudicated. NORMALIZE = a safe transcription fix of a KNOWN entity (spelling/casing/punctuation), applied to frozen content with provenance. DESIGNER_FLAG = a real inconsistency whose fix is a guess; under faithful reconstruction (no source) we DO NOT invent it — text is left as-is and the question goes to the designer. Both keys count as adjudicated so the lint stays green.

Channelling.rationale: British spelling; the glossary term is 'Channeling'. Normalizing lets the keyword resolve.

Zek'vir.rationale: Transposition typo of the hero's own name (Zev'kir) within his skill Repulse.

Hectors Serums.rationale: Missing possessive apostrophe; every other reference is 'Hector's Serum(s)'.

Prisma Scarlet.rationale: Designer ruling 2026-08-13: the red Ranger is canonically 'Prisma Crimson' (minion table + 'Crimson Crash'). Normalizing the lone 'Scarlet' reference in the description. The augment's flavor name 'Scarlet Somersault Crash' is left as-is.

Prisma Citrine.rationale: Designer ruling 2026-08-13: the yellow Ranger is canonically 'Prisma Saffron' (minion table + skill stem 'saffron'). Normalizing the 'Citrine' reference. Skill name 'Citrine Lens' left as-is.

Keeper of Tales.rationale: Designer ruling 2026-08-13: typo for the character's name 'Keeper of Fables' (23x vs 3x). His resources 'Tales to Tell' / 'Chronicle Fragments' are unaffected.
